_comment: The fixed half of every English cover letter. Markdown allowed. The specific half lives in applications/<slug>/cover-letter.json. Order in the letter: letter.intro, fixed.about_me, letter.body, fixed.closing; letter.intro (one sentence) and the first about_me paragraph form one paragraph. Subject: cover-letter.json's own "subject" wins; otherwise subject_with_reference when posting.reference is set, else subject_default. Salutation: cover-letter.json's own "salutation" wins; otherwise salutation_named[posting.contact.salutation] ("_" when the title is unknown) with {salutation} {first_name} {last_name}; otherwise salutation_default. email_body: the paragraphs of the covering email when the employer takes applications by email (form_url mailto:); placeholders {role}, {company}, {reference}.
subject_with_reference: Application for the position of {role}, ref. {reference}
about_me: I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Information and Data Science at the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences. Alongside my studies I work as a working student in data analytics, automating reports and building dashboards for the controlling team.
closing: I would be delighted to discuss my application with you in person.
email_body: I would like to apply for the position of {role}. Please find my cover letter, CV and references attached.
I look forward to hearing from you.
